title: The As-If Machine: Personalized counterfactuals make distant policy risks feel close
abstract: arXiv:2610.33301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Life experiences can shape policy attitudes, but we only live one life. Citizens may therefore fail to support policies addressing risks they have never personally experienced. Narratives can make such risks immediate and personal, but personalized stories remain difficult to produce at scale. Here we ask whether AI can make distant scenarios feel concrete by simulating a participant's life as if that scenario occurred. We present the As-If Machine (AIM), a multi-agent system through which people co-write personalized counterfactual narratives---stories about their own lives under different policy futures. In two pre-registered and quota-matched experiments on science funding (N=1,007) and satellite cybersecurity (N=894), we compared AIM with two controls: reading an expert-written vignette on the same topic and co-writing with AIM about an unrelated topic. translated_title: “假如”机器：个性化反事实叙事让遥远的风险变得切身相关
translated_abstract: 生活经历能够塑造政策态度，但我们只能活一次人生。因此，公民可能难以支持那些应对他们从未亲身经历过的风险的政策。叙事可以让此类风险变得即时而切身，但个性化的故事一直难以大规模生产。本研究探讨人工智能能否通过模拟参与者的生活——仿佛该情景真的发生——来让遥远的情景变得具体可感。我们提出了“假如机器”（AIM），这是一个多智能体系统，人们可以通过它与AI共同创作个性化的反事实叙事——即讲述自己在不同政策未来下生活的故事。在两项预先注册且配额匹配的实验中，分别针对科学资助（N=1,007）和卫星网络安全（N=894）议题，我们将AIM与两个对照组进行了比较：阅读同一主题下专家撰写的短文，以及与AIM共同撰写无关主题的内容。AIM提高了心理亲近感——即风险在自我感知上的贴近程度——提升了……
tldr: 本研究开发了多智能体系统“假如机器”（AIM），让用户与AI共同创作关于自身生活的个性化反事实叙事，两项实验证明这种叙事比专家撰写的短文更能提升遥远政策风险的心理亲近感。
en_tdlr: The As-If Machine (AIM), a multi-agent system that lets people co-write personalized counterfactual narratives about their own lives, makes distant policy risks feel psychologically closer than reading expert-written vignettes.
